# cffi: Required by `cryptography`'s Rust bindings: without it, importing `cryptography` raises `ModuleNotFoundError: _cffi_backend` and then PANICS under pyo3 — a failure at IMPORT time, before any code runs. Measured 2026-09-19 in this container while scoping `d5f1`; installing `cffi` was what made `pypdf` usable at all. (no direct import)
# imports: cffi
cffi

# cryptography: `pypdf_safe.py`. Present system-wide in this container, which is precisely why it went undeclared in the first draft of this list — the checker caught it, and 'it happens to be installed here' is how an undeclared dependency is born.
# imports: cryptography
cryptography

# lxml: `smart-base-transform.py` and both translation extract/inject scripts — XML with namespaces, which `xml.etree` handles poorly enough to matter here.
# imports: lxml
lxml

# pdfminer.six: `pdf-extract.py`. The distribution name differs from the import name, which is exactly what `imports` exists for.
# imports: pdfminer
pdfminer.six

# pdfplumber: `_pypdf_compat.py`'s second backend, so a document one reader cannot open is not simply refused.
# imports: pdfplumber
pdfplumber

# pillow: Required by `pypdf` for image extraction: without it `page.images` raises `ImportError: pillow is required` at the point of use, while `len(page.images)` quietly returns 0 — a false zero measured 2026-09-19 while scoping `d5f1`. (no direct import)
# imports: PIL
pillow

# pymupdf: The PDF backend for `pdf-structure.py` and `pdf-pages.py` — embedded outline, page text, page count. The single most load-bearing dependency here and the one nothing declared.
# imports: pymupdf
pymupdf

# pypdf: `pdf-extract.py`, `pypdf_safe.py` and `_pypdf_compat.py`. Also the image-extraction path, which is why Pillow is below.
# imports: pypdf
pypdf

# PyYAML: `translation_config.py`. Imports as `yaml`.
# imports: yaml
PyYAML

# requests: The five translation scripts that reach Crowdin, Launchpad and Weblate.
